data.title: A criterion that does not apply is waived with a reason, not removed or scoped away
data.why: The board's definition of done is engineering-shaped: 'npm test green' landed on interviews and on the site's landing task, and 10 of 67 done tasks closed with criteria that never applied. Waiving keeps the line and records, in the journal, that it was set aside on purpose and why — and it fixes tasks that already exist. The journal is append-only, so removal was never on the table.
data.rejected: A definition of done scoped by type or label: helps only new tasks, and an interview and a feature are both stories; task ac remove: would rewrite what a task promised, in a journal that never takes anything back
